title: AlloFlow Teacher Guide
description: Practical, classroom-centered guidance for planning, teaching, accessibility, live lessons, and responsible use.

paths.title: I am planning my first lesson
paths.description: Start with a focused, student-ready resource and a teacher review gate.

paths.title: I am running a live class
paths.description: Prepare the room, route supports, recover calmly, and review evidence.

paths.title: I need a routine for a specific classroom need
paths.description: Start from a worked recipe and adapt it to your students and source.

paths.title: I support accessibility
paths.description: Check learner experience, response options, and specialist workflows.

paths.title: I am leading a school rollout
paths.description: Set shared guardrails, coach teachers, and measure useful implementation signals.

paths.title: Something is not working
paths.description: Protect instructional time with a recovery sequence and a stable fallback.
